propositions: rebar explain plan/review/criterion-id fails with missing-file when rebar is installed as a library/CLI and run against a project lacking docs/ because guides are resolved from consuming project's repo_root, not rebar's package
guides must be accessible from any rebar installation via importlib.resources using the in-package canonical sources under src/rebar/_guides/
explain_guide(name) must resolve guide markdown independent of repo_root_path parameter by reading from packaged resources
explain_criterion(id) must render sections from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md from repo root
docs/ directory must retain thin pointer files to maintain backward compatibility with existing links in docs/README.md and AGENTS.md
CLI, MCP, and library surfaces must each succeed with rebar explain plan|review|F1 when REBAR_ROOT has no docs/ tree
